detail.title: CP-UNP-F4521L30-DPQ
detail.overview: 2MP 45x Full HD Network IR PTZ Camera– 300 Mtr.
features: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264H, H.264B, MJPEG
WDR(120dB), Day/Night(ICR), 2D NR/ 3D NR, ROI, Defog, AWB, AGC, BLC, HLC,
Up to 300 Presets, 5 Scan, 8 Tour, 5 Pattern
CMS Software: KVMS Pro Lite, EVMS Pro

General.Minimum Illumination: 0.005 lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE), 0.0005 lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE), 0 lux@F1.6 (illuminator on)
General.White Balance: Auto, Indoor, Outdoor, ATW, Manual, Sodium lamp, Natural light, Street lamp
General.Pan & Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless, Tilt: –20° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 Areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view
General.Special Features: Up to 300 Presets, 5 Pattern, 8  (up to 32 presets per tour) Tour, 5 Scan
General.IR Control: Zoom Prio, Manual, Smart IR, Off
General.Overlay: Channel Title, Time Title, OSD Info (PTZ Coordinate, Zoom, North, Pattern, Temperature, Preset,  Location, Input Text, Text Alignment), Font Properties, Custom Title, Exception Overlay
General.Video Compression: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264H, H.264B MJPEG (Sub Stream)
General.Bit Rate: H265: 86 kbps–5632 kbps, H264: 216 kbps–8192 kbps
General.Audio Compression: PCM, G.711a, G.711Mu, G.726, MPEG2-Layer2, G722.1, AAC
General.Tracking Trigger Event: Crossing virtual fence, Tripwire, Intrusion, Abandoned Object, Fast Moving, Parking Detection,  Loitering Detection
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture, Recording, Send email, Preset, Tour, Pattern, Alarm digital output
General.Event Alarm: Motion/tampering detection, Defocus Detection, Audio detection, SD Card Exception(No SD  card, Low SD card space, SD card error), Network Exception (Offline, IP Conflict), External  Alarm, IMD, Security Warning, AI Events
General.Protocol: IPv4, IPv6, HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, RTP, RTSP, RTCP, RTMP, SMTP V3, SFTP, DHCP, DNS, QoS,  UPnP, NTP, Multicast, ICMP, IGMP, NAS, PPPoE, SNMP, Auto Connect, TLS v1.2 and v1.3,  ONVIF (Profile S, Profile G, Profile T), InstaOn
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Crossing virtual fence, Tripwire, Intrusion, Abandoned Object, Fast Moving, Parking Detection,  Crowd Gathering, Missing Object, Loitering Detection, IMD
General.Face Detection: Face detection, Face Enhancement, Face Cutout (Face/ One Inch Photo), Snapshot Mode (Real-Time/ Quality Priority), Optimal face snapshot upload, Quality Threshol
General.Cyber Security: AES 256-bit Encryption, Configuration encryption, Trusted execution, Digest, Security logs,  WSSE, Account lockout, Syslog, Video encryption, 802.1x, Allow list/Block list, HTTPS, Trusted  upgrade, Trusted boot, Firmware encryption
General.Weatherproof Standard: IP67, IK10, TVS 8000V lightning proof, surge  protection, voltage transient protection
General.Certificates: MTBF Certificate from STQC, EMI/EMC, ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 20000-1 : 2018, CE, FCC and RoHS,  BIS
General.Power Consumption: 24 VDC, 2.5 A ± 25%: Basic: 13 W; Max: 25 W (illuminator + PTZ) PoE+ (802.3at): Basic: 13 W;  Max: 25 W (illuminator + PTZ)
